name: ontos-model-integration
description: Split-skill workflow for integrating new LLM models into Ontos serving simulation with vLLM-grounded analysis and KP-driven validation.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate Ontos models with split workflows and KP checks.
interface.longDescription: Ontos Model Integration packages the former monolithic model-integrator workflow into smaller Codex skills for intake, vLLM implementation analysis, model dimension analysis, planning, validation, and keypoint management. It includes a complete KP reference bundle and legacy copies of the original model-integrator and kp-manager skills for auditability.
defaultPrompt: Plan a new Ontos model integration.
Audit an Ontos integration plan against KP docs.
Capture and route a new Ontos integration keypoint.
